summary_md: **@CryptoJohn🔥 ([@JohnonETH](https://x.com/JohnonETH/status/2115736582695051598))** points to MemOS's **MemT 1.0**, which keeps learned experience in a fixed-size internal memory instead of a growing context; across three SWE-bench Verified runs it resolved 54% of bug-fix tasks unaided and rose to 62.8% once relevant experience was injected at the point where it got stuck ([MemTensor MemT-1 collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/MemTensor/memt-1)).
relevance: Native-memory model for agents that learn from experience.
